attention mechanism to infuse global distribution information into the untouched chan-
nels of PConv. Second, we introduce the spatial-wise attention to the MLP layer to
further improve model accuracy. Finally, we replace PAT_ch in the last stage with the
self-attention mechanism to extend the global receptive field. Building upon PAT, we
propose a novel hybrid network family, named PATNet, which achieves superior top-1
accuracy and inference speed compared to FasterNet on ImageNet-1K classification and
excel in both detection and segmentation on the COCO dataset. Particularly, our PATNet-
T2 achieves 1.3% higher accuracy than FasterNet-T2, while exhibiting 25% higher GPU
throughput and 24% lower CPU latency.

---

  3. **Partial Self-Attention Block (PAT_sf)**: Extends the global receptive field by replacing PAT_ch with self-attention.
